parameters.name: by_integration
parameters.description: 1 = group by integration, 0 = group by instance (default: 1)

parameters.name: in_stock_only
parameters.description: 1 = only include products with stock at warehouse 0 (default), 0 = include all products

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search by SKU or supplier name (LIKE match against both)

parameters.name: filter[product_types]
parameters.description: Filter by product types (comma-separated: standard | blemished | kit)
